author: reek
body: The shapes that lower to a LIR function with NO instructions: a single block whose result is a parameter or an immediate. `ident` lowers to `b0: => v0`, `konst` to `b0: => #42`, `pick2` to `b0: => v1`.

author: reek
body: This is the first construct the ARM64 LIR selector claims (`codex/plugs/arm64/Arm64Lir.codex`), so on that backend these definitions are emitted by a different code path from every other function in the file. x86-64 compiles them the way it always did, which is what makes the two answers comparable.

author: reek
body: `via-call` exists so the answers are not read only from the definitions themselves: it calls them, which means the function offsets and arities the selector registers have to be right for an ordinary call to land.
